title: Parallax Arena - Shifting Strata
description: A surreal floating arena composed of cracked teal and purple crystalline platforms suspended in the night sky. At the center sits an ornate mechanical wheel device connected by ropes and ladders to tall golden columns, with a ruined gothic city visible in the background under a large crescent moon.
prompt: Surreal floating arena made of cracked teal and purple crystalline platforms hovering in a dark night sky, ornate mechanical wheel device at the center connected by ropes and ladders to tall golden columns, ruined gothic city silhouette in the background, large glowing crescent moon, scattered papers and debris on the lower sandy platform, dramatic cinematic lighting, detailed fantasy illustration
